part1Questions: Can you tell me a little about where you live?
Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What do you like most about your neighbourhood?
Is there anything you would change about it?
Do you work or are you a student?
What do you enjoy most about your work or studies?
What did you want to be when you were a child?
How do you usually spend your free time?
Did you have a favourite hobby as a child?
Do you prefer spending free time alone or with other people?

part2CueCard.topic: Describe a book you have read that you enjoyed.
bulletPoints: when and where you read it
why you decided to read it
and explain why you enjoyed it

part3Questions: What kinds of books are most popular in your country?
Do you think reading habits have changed in recent years? Why?
How do children benefit from reading books at a young age?
Do you think people will still read printed books in the future, or only digital ones?
Some people say films are better than books for telling a story. Do you agree?

part1Questions: Do you live with your family or on your own?
How much time do you usually spend with your family?
What do you usually do together as a family?
What does a typical day look like for you?
Is your daily routine different on weekends?
What is your favourite meal of the day?
Do you prefer eating at home or eating out?
What kind of food do you enjoy most?
Have you ever tried cooking a new dish? How did it go?
Is food an important part of celebrations in your culture?

part2CueCard.topic: Describe a memorable journey or trip you have taken.
bulletPoints: what you did during the trip
and explain why the trip was memorable for you

part3Questions: Why do you think people enjoy travelling to new places?
What are the benefits of travelling for young people?
Do you think tourism has more advantages or disadvantages for a country?
How has travelling changed over the last twenty years?
Do you think it is better to travel alone or in a group? Why?

part1Questions: What hobbies or interests do you have?
How did you first become interested in this hobby?
How much time do you spend on your hobbies each week?
Do you use technology much in your daily life?
What device do you use most often — a phone, a computer, or something else?
Has technology made your life easier or more complicated?
What is the weather like in your country at this time of year?
What is your favourite season? Why?
Does the weather affect your mood or your plans?
Do you prefer hot weather or cold weather?

part2CueCard.topic: Describe a person who has had a positive influence on your life.
bulletPoints: what they have done that influenced you
and explain why this influence has been important to you

part3Questions: What qualities make someone a good role model?
Do you think famous people, like celebrities, have a responsibility to be good role models?
How do parents influence the values of their children?
Do you think teachers have as much influence on young people as parents do?
Has social media changed who young people look up to nowadays?

part1Questions: Can you describe the area where you grew up?
What kind of shops are there near where you live?
Do you enjoy shopping? Why or why not?
Do you prefer shopping online or in physical shops?
What kind of music do you like to listen to?
Do you play any musical instruments?
Do you listen to music while you study or work?
Has your taste in music changed since you were younger?
Do you often go to concerts or live music events?
Is music an important part of celebrations in your country?

part2CueCard.topic: Describe a skill you would like to learn in the future.
bulletPoints: how much time it would take to learn
and explain why you want to learn this skill

part3Questions: What skills do you think are most useful for young people to learn today?
Do you think schools should teach practical skills as well as academic subjects?
How has the internet changed the way people learn new skills?
Do you think it's harder to learn new skills as an adult compared to a child?
What role does motivation play in successfully learning something new?
